title: Change miles into kilometres from a conversion graph
source: Theory IGCSE-13.4 Quick check 1 (10 miles = 16 km); book style pp.418-419, new numbers, rate 8 km for every 5 miles
stem: A conversion graph is a straight line through \(0\) miles \(=0\) km and \(50\) miles \(=80\) km. Change \(({m|int})\) miles into kilometres.

steps.name: A
steps.note: The line through the origin and 50 miles = 80 km has gradient 8/5.

contexts.stem: A conversion graph is a straight line through \(0\) miles \(=0\) km and \(50\) miles \(=80\) km. How many kilometres are equal to \(({m|int})\) miles?

title: Change kilometres into miles from a conversion graph
source: Theory IGCSE-13.4 Quick check 2 (40 km = 25 miles); book style p.420, new numbers
stem: A conversion graph is a straight line through \(0\) miles \(=0\) km and \(50\) miles \(=80\) km. Change \(({k|int})\) km into miles.

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: \(1\) km \(=\dfrac{5}{8}\) of a mile, so \(({k|int})\) km \(=({k|int})\times\dfrac{5}{8}={M|int}\) miles
